title: ageratina gracilis
intro: Ageratina gracilis, commonly known as Skuul, is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae, native to the regions of Mexico and Central America. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina gracilis include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of digestive issues, among others. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
